about: Which title IDs are one game, where the automatic matching cannot tell. games[] joins title IDs into one game (name, aliases, image optional; sources required); distinct[] keeps title IDs apart. Everything else is matched by the build: one PlayStation Store concept, or names that agree once spelling, symbols, editions and short forms are set aside. See AGENTS.md, section Games.

distinct.reason: Two homebrew apps: Nuvio Max'd (PPSA99288) is a separate native build with its own releases (HandshakeHackin/Nuvio-maxd-releases, per boykopovar/AnyPS5#4454), not the Nuvio PS5 app (PPSA99997).
